WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE
Notification
METAL QUARRY AND METAL CRUSHING TRADE

IT is hereby notified under Regulation 30 of the Wages Boards Regulations published in Gazette No. 14961 dated04.06.1971 that the Hon. Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations has been pleased to appoint the following personsto be members of the Wages Board for the Metal Quarry and Metal Crushin Trade, by virtue of the powers vested in theHon. Minister of Labour under Section 09 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) No. 27 of 1941, for a period ofthree years commencing on 15th August 2016.
S. M. GOTABAYA JAYARATHNE,Secretary,Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations.Labour Secretariat,Colombo 05,30th December 2016.
Nominated Members :
1.Mr. I. W. Chandrasiri2.Mr. H. D. Karunarathna3.Mr. G. Thissakuttiarachchi
